title.rendered: Private House Party Los Altos DJ

content.rendered:
7pm to 3am on Saturday, 16th March 2013

A few guys are going to perform after the girls perform. Please don’t share the song with anyone. At the end of the bollywood song we will jump to the Harlem Shake
